welcome.title: Your own Minecraft server, in about a minute
welcome.subtitle: Pick a version, pick a flavour, hit start. MCServerSmith downloads the server files and the exact Java runtime it needs — no terminal, no wiki pages, no port forwarding.
welcome.f1.title: Every flavour, one click
welcome.f1.body: Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Folia, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Velocity. Server jars and dependencies are fetched automatically and verified against their published checksums.
welcome.f2.title: The right Java, automatically
welcome.f2.body: Java 8, 17, 21 or 25 — we read the required version straight out of the server jar and install exactly that runtime. This is where most do-it-yourself launchers break.
welcome.f3.title: A real dashboard
welcome.f3.body: Players online, connection address, live console, TPS, RAM and CPU of the server process, world size, backups and a plugin browser — all in one window.
welcome.f4.title: Supporter features
welcome.f4.body: The app is free and stays free. A one-time supporter key adds scheduled restarts, automatic backups, crash auto-restart and the tunnel feature.
wizard.title: Create a server
wizard.step1: Step 1 of 4 — Name and server type
wizard.name: Server name
wizard.advanced: This server type is for advanced users
wizard.onlineMode: Online mode (verify players against Mojang — keep this on for public servers)
type.vanilla.desc: Official Mojang server. Most stable, no plugins, no optimisations.
type.paper.desc: Best default for survival and plugin servers: fast, well optimised, huge plugin ecosystem.
type.purpur.desc: Paper fork with tons of gameplay toggles. Great if you want to tune everything.
type.folia.desc: Paper fork with regionised multithreading. Huge performance for big player counts, but many plugins are incompatible.
type.fabric.desc: Lightweight mod loader. Best choice for performance mods.
type.forge.desc: The classic mod loader. Needed for most older modpacks and many big mods.
type.neoforge.desc: Modern Forge fork, the default for Minecraft 1.20.2+ modpacks.
type.spigot.desc: The original plugin server. Still works, but Paper is faster and much easier to install.
type.velocity.desc: Proxy server to link several backend servers behind one address. Not a game server itself.
install.title: Installing
install.done: Installation finished — you can start the server now
console.placeholder: Type a command (e.g. list, op Notch, say hello)
console.hint: Commands go straight into the server console. Admins, world edits and plugins all work through this box.
players.name: Player name
players.hint: The player list comes from the server query/RCON interface. Names may take a few seconds to appear after a login.
addons.hint: Results are filtered for Minecraft {v} and this server type. Modrinth and Hangar are open APIs; SpigotMC has no API, so it is not offered.
addons.none: Nothing installed yet. Addons are downloaded straight into the server folder.
backups.title: Backups
backups.autoEnabled: Back up automatically while the server runs
backups.gated: Automatic backups with retention are a supporter feature. Manual backups are always free.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? The current world will be replaced. The server must be stopped.
network.explain: Inside your own network the local address always works. From the internet your router must forward the port — the button below tries to set that up automatically via UPnP, which fails on carrier-grade NAT.
network.gated: Tunnels are a supporter feature: they make your server reachable without any router setup.
network.ipWarning: Note: through a plain TCP tunnel every player appears to come from the tunnel host, so IP bans and IP-based plugins see one address. frp can preserve real IPs with PROXY protocol, which needs the HAProxyDetector plugin on the server.
tunnel.proxyProtocol: Preserve player IPs (PROXY protocol v2, needs HAProxyDetector)
tunnel.playitPath: Path to the playit agent binary
tunnel.customRegex: Regex that captures the public address
config.title: server.properties
config.hint: These values go straight into server.properties. Restart the server for changes to take effect.
config.reinstallHint: Reinstalling re-downloads the server jar and keeps your world. Use it after changing the version or if the jar got damaged.
config.reinstallConfirm: Reinstall the server files? Your world and settings are kept.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Application preferences
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.autoPortForward: Try automatic port forwarding (UPnP) when a server starts
settings.translationsHint: Export the English template, translate the values, and import the file back. Files land in the app's locales folder and are picked up immediately — share them with the community so everyone benefits.
settings.disclaimer: NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
settings.showPublicIp: Show my public IP in the dashboard (asks api.ipify.org)
settings.privacyNote: MCServerSmith collects no telemetry and needs no account. The only third-party request the dashboard makes is the public IP lookup above; server jars, Java runtimes, plugins and mods are downloaded from their official sources.
files.simpleHint: Only the places you normally touch: the world, the mods or plugins folder, the logs and the important config files. Switch to Advanced to browse the whole server folder.
files.name: Name
files.dblclickHint: Double-click to open, F2 renames, Delete removes
files.dropHint: Drop files or folders here to add them
files.newFilePrompt: Name of the new file (e.g. notes.txt)
files.editorHint: Ctrl+S saves, Esc closes. A .bak copy of the previous version is kept.
files.tailHint: Only the end of this large file is shown, so it is read-only.
files.binaryHint: That is not a text file — opening it with the default app instead.
runtimes.title: Java runtimes
runtimes.subtitle: Downloaded once, shared by every server
runtimes.hint: MCServerSmith installs only the Java versions your servers actually need. They live in the data folder and are reused by all servers.
runtimes.none: No runtimes installed yet — they arrive with the first server.
cloud.title: Run it 24/7 in the cloud
cloud.subtitle: For when your PC should not have to stay on
cloud.intro: A local server only runs while your computer runs. A small cloud machine (from about the price of a coffee per month) keeps it online around the clock — and you keep using this same dashboard.
cloud.howto: How it works: rent the smallest VPS, install Java, upload your server folder, done. The same instance files you have here run there unchanged.
cloud.selfHost: Prefer to build the whole thing yourself?
cloud.selfHostBody: Every piece this app uses is open: Modrinth/Hangar for addons, Adoptium for Java, frp for tunnels. If you want to run your own relay (and hand out your own player addresses later), start with a cheap VPS and frp — the tunnel tab already speaks to it.
license.title: Supporter
license.subtitle: Optional — the app is free
license.removePrompt: Paste the full key you want to remove:
license.offlineHint: Keys are verified offline with a signature — no account, no server, no telemetry. Your key never leaves this machine.
license.free.3: Manual backups, LAN play, UPnP port forwarding
license.pro.1: Tunnel: play together without port forwarding
license.pro.2: Scheduled restarts (e.g. nightly at 04:00) with a backup first
license.howtoBtn: How do I get a key?
license.howtoBody:
The developer has not connected a shop link to this build yet.

When they do, keys are sold through any hosted checkout (Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Ko-fi, …) and delivered as a text string you paste here. Verification happens offline, so no account is needed.
license.sellTitle: For the operator of this build
license.sellBody:
Mint keys offline with:  node tools/keygen.js --keygen  (once), then  node tools/keygen.js --mint --tier supporter

Sell them anywhere that can deliver a text line — Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Ko-fi, Discord, a manual invoice. No website, no server, no VAT handling in the app. Paste the printed public key into src/main/licensing/license.js and rebuild.
upsell.cloud.headline: Keep it online 24/7
upsell.cloud.body: Your server is running off your own PC. A small cloud box keeps it online while you sleep.
upsell.tunnel.headline: Play together without port forwarding
upsell.tunnel.body: Open a tunnel so friends can join through a simple address.
eula.notice: Minecraft requires you to accept the Mojang EULA before a server can run. This only sets eula=true in eula.txt.
